name: Liébana
terms: Spain's regional wine tier, below DO.
Young wine, sold with little or no aging. Some see a few months in oak.

blurb.text: A vino de la tierra in Cantabria on Spain's north coast, covering the municipalities of Potes, Pesaguero, Camaleño and others.
